done_when: In the machine's agent line, a waiting run for an item that other planned work waits on starts before runs nothing waits on, first-come within each group, and its place in line says why. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Test — The queue test makes SAVE and SHOW prerequisites only through the plan’s `After` cells (lines 58–61). It never exercises a draft task whose Scope overlaps a started task but has no explicit `After` entry. In that normal case, the draft task must wait for the started task; removing the Scope argument from `_unblocks` at `src/forge/machine.py:99–100` would break its queue priority while this test and the board’s separate scope test still pass. The ruled scope-blocker behavior lacks an end-to-end admission test.
findings.title: Not done: scope-only blocker admission test

why: The machine's agent line is first-come, so a part other work waits on queues behind new fixes
